title: mail-server: Mailbox name localizable (canonical crate); Identity/VacationResponse excluded
description:
jmap-mail-server (with mail-types): Mailbox `name` is localizable.
- Opt-in attach call per child .1(a).
- impl Localizable for Mailbox: [name, not nullable].
- Sibling-name uniqueness on base names only. Localized names SHOULD meet Net-Unicode (RFC 5198) like base names: reuse the existing name validation.
- Do NOT add Identity, ParticipantIdentity or VacationResponse. The draft excludes them; note this in the rustdoc so nobody "fixes" it.
- The canonical crate for the pattern; the other families copy it.
Tests: Mailbox/get with language, /query sorted by localized name, duplicate localized sibling names allowed.
notes:
From .5: Mailbox/query and /queryChanges handlers parse language (I18nProjection::from_args), pass QueryParams/QueryChangesParams::language, wrap queryState (localized_query_state) and unwrap sinceQueryState (unwrap_query_state); memory backend sorts/filters name on jmap_types::i18n::localized_value. Owns the test: sort Mailboxes by localized name; language mismatch on queryChanges.
Done 2026-11-15. Shape follows decision 27 (no attach call; bead's '.1(a) attach call' is superseded): MailBackend's JmapBackend::i18n_info gates. No Net-Unicode check exists on base Mailbox names, so localized names get the same (type-only) checks; Net-Unicode for both is a separate gap. Pattern for .8-.10: type fields + LOCALIZABLE + CLIENT_SETTABLE; handler: I18nProjection in get/query/queryChanges, I18nSet in set (check_create after clone, check_patch with the metadata check, echo on created/updated); memory backend: localized_update after apply_patch_object, return Some(obj) when pruned, i18n_info Some.
close_reason: Mailbox name localizable end to end: type fields, /get view, /query+/queryChanges language and queryState, /set checks, memory backend pruning and localized sort/filter; 8 tests
